decision.body:
ask your agent to split this into logical pieces, Sol thinks that would be productive

```
› Could it have been split into multiple PRs productively?


• Yes, productively:

  1. Preserve expression structure: leaf mapping, xreplace, cache preflight, and
     regression tests for u0 + u1. This is the actual bug fix.

  2. Environment identity: prevent equal symbol names from distinct ShapeEnvs
     aliasing. This needs a durable identity design, not id().

  3. Range propagation: decide whether derived-size leaves become size_like.
     This is a separate semantic change and currently appears unsound.

  The hint-copying and opaque fallback handling belong with PR 1 because they
  preserve existing behavior during the algorithm change. Splitting the other
  two would make the core fix easier to validate and prevent unrelated policy
  decisions from blocking it.
```
